text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I saw it on TV and thought it was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Um, I want you to read it right now!
Because I'm right here!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
I wrote this hoping it would
give you strength, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I want to see if that gets conveyed properly and fills everyone with energy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(To Ayabe-oneesan,
I'm always cheering for you!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Blue, fast, and so cool.
I'll do my best and run hard too.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
("I'll keep cheering for you lots and lots.
Good luck!")

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: H-How's that? Feel your strength swelling up?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
""Ah, right in front of this station! The interaction between Admire
Vega and the little girl was shared on social media by a passerby
and quickly went viral—""

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"And you know what? Big Sis Ayabe
cheered up thanks to my letter!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'd really rather avoid that for a while, though.
